name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding & Enablement Specialist | SaaS Implementation, Client Training & Product Adoption
summary: SaaS onboarding and enablement specialist who gets clients from signed contract to confident, daily use. At Wix I onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month (110% of implementation targets) and trained onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly sessions and 1:1 coaching. At Birdeye I trained a partner network on marketing automation, tracked utilization to catch low-adoption accounts early, and retained all but one of 15-20 partners. Today I map manual client workflows and rebuild them as automated systems, which is the same shift Ottimate clients make from manual AP to automation.
